decoded.meaning: BATCH{ TIME u64=1700000000000000000, VALUE i32[3]={0,1500,-250}, VALUE u16=0x0064, VALUE u16=0x0065, VALUE u16=0x0066 } — a batch the APPLICATION composed (RFC-0025 §4.1.3, Amendment 4), STANDALONE carriage: the assigned user-range record type 0x80. Non-uniform stream (descriptor dt_ns = 0), so the packed i32 LE offset run sits in one VALUE child between the TIME base and the sample frames: t(i) = base + offsets[i]
decoded.note: the sample frames' bytes are IDENTICAL to the bytes the app already held — a composition references them, it does not re-encode them. An implementation that re-encodes a sample, or that spends a per-sample trailer (the retired §4.2 spelling), does not produce these bytes. Byte-identical to stream/batch-composed-folded except the first byte (0x80 -> 0x01 VALUE), which is the whole of what a carriage changes
